target: forge.sh pr-state (gitlab) — HTTP errors, transport errors and unusable bodies print UNKNOWN and exit 0, never MERGED (mutation target)
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/sub/proj.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
P="/api/v4/projects/grp%2Fsub%2Fproj/merge_requests/7"
U=https://gitlab.example.test/grp/sub/proj/-/merge_requests/7
t() { fx_run pr-state "$U"; echo "$1=$FX_OUT rc=$FX_RC"; }
fx_http "GET $P" 404 '{"message":"404 Not found"}'; t e404
fx_http "GET $P" 500 '{"message":"boom"}'; t e500
fx_http "GET $P" 401 '{"message":"401 Unauthorized"}'; t e401
fx_http "GET $P" 403 '{"message":"403 Forbidden"}'; t e403
fx_http "GET $P" 404 '{"state":"merged"}'; t e404merged
fx_http "GET $P" 500 '{"state":"merged"}'; t e500merged
fx_http "GET $P" transport-error; t transport
fx_http "GET $P" 200 'not json at all'; t notjson
fx_http "GET $P" 200 '{}'; t empty
fx_http "GET $P" 200 '{"state":null}'; t nullstate
echo "reqs_before_control=$(fx_nreq)"
fx_http "GET $P" 200 '{"state":"merged"}'; t control
fx_done
